title: Taiwan Railways station basic information dataset
license_note: Official government open data; retained for personal research with source attribution.
relevant_locator: stationCode, stationName, stationEName, stationAddrTw, stationAddrEn, stationTel, gps

temporal_proof_requirements.required_for_opening_promotion: A frozen snapshot demonstrably published no later than 2025-09-01, or independently dated station records covering the bookmark.

reliability_notes: Authoritative current directory reference. The postbookmark retrieval cannot prove bookmark station status, service, capacity, ownership, military access, or operability.

title: Passenger and freight origins and destinations by station and line, calendar year 2021
license_note: Official government open data; retained for personal research with source attribution.
relevant_locator: year, station or line, boardings, alightings, originating tonnes, arriving tonnes
temporal_proof: The official catalog metadata is dated 2024-08-26, before the 2025-09-01 bookmark, and the retained content contains only calendar year 2021 observations.
reliability_notes: Authoritative historical flow data. Station freight detail is intentionally not disclosed; the published freight rows are line aggregates and may not be assigned to a station. The pandemic-era 2021 passenger counts are observations, not a 2025 utilization or capacity estimate.
